title: Molecular Characterization of Primary and Metastatic Colon Cancer Cells to Identify Therapeutic Targets with Natural Compounds.
authors: Jothimani, Ganesan; Ganesan, Harsha; Pathak, Surajit; Banerjee, Antara
one_liner_zh: 该文主要表征原发与转移性结肠癌细胞的免疫和基因表达谱，仅对Wnt信号蛋白与植物化合物做分子对接，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Metastasis is the world's leading cause of colon cancer morbidity. Due to its heterogeneity, it has been challenging to understand primary to metastatic colon cancer progression and find a molecular target for colon cancer treatment. OBJECTIVES: The current investigation aimed to characterize the immune and genotypic profiles of primary and metastatic colon cancer cell lines and identify a molecular target for colon cancer treatment. METHODS: Colony-forming potential, migration and invasion potential, cytokine profiling, miRNA, and mRNA expression were examined. Molecular docking for the Wnt signaling proteins with various plant compounds was performed. RESULTS: Colony formation, migration, and invasion potential were significantly higher in metastatic cells. The primary and metastatic cells' local immune and genetic status revealed TGF beta-1, IL-8, MIP-1b, I-TAC, GM-CSF, and MCP-1 were highly expressed in all cancer cells. RANTES, IL-4, IL- 6, IFNgamma, and G-CSF were less expressed in cancer cell lines. mRNA expression analysis displayed significant overexpression of proliferation, cell cycle, and oncogenes, whereas apoptosis cascade and tumor suppressor genes were significantly down-regulated in metastatic cells more evidently. Most importantly, the results of molecular docking with dysregulated Wnt signaling proteins shows that peptide AGAP and coronaridine had maximum hydrogen bonds to beta-catenin and GSK3beta with a better binding affinity. CONCLUSION: This study emphasized genotypic differences between the primary and metastatic colon cancer cells, delineating the intricate mechanisms to understand the primary to metastatic advancement. The molecular docking aided in understanding the future molecular targets for bioactive- based colon cancer therapeutic interventions.
abstract_zh: 背景：转移是结肠癌发病率和死亡率的主要原因。由于其异质性，理解从原发性到转移性结肠癌的进展并寻找结肠癌治疗的分子靶点一直具有挑战性。目的：本研究旨在表征原发性和转移性结肠癌细胞系的免疫和基因型特征，并确定结肠癌治疗的分子靶点。方法：检测了集落形成能力、迁移和侵袭能力、细胞因子谱、miRNA和mRNA表达。对Wnt信号蛋白与多种植物化合物进行了分子对接。结果：转移细胞的集落形成、迁移和侵袭能力显著更高。原发性和转移性细胞的局部免疫和遗传状态显示，TGF beta-1、IL-8、MIP-1b、I-TAC、GM-CSF和MCP-1在所有癌细胞中高表达。RANTES、IL-4、IL-6、IFNgamma和G-CSF在癌细胞系中表达较低。mRNA表达分析显示，增殖、细胞周期和癌基因显著过表达，而凋亡级联和肿瘤抑制基因在转移细胞中显著下调，且更为明显。最重要的是，与失调的Wnt信号蛋白的分子对接结果显示，肽AGAP和冠花碱与β-catenin和GSK3beta具有最大氢键数，且结合亲和力更优。结论：本研究强调了原发性和转移性结肠癌细胞之间的基因型差异，描绘了理解从原发性到转移性进展的复杂机制。分子对接有助于理解未来基于生物活性物质的结肠癌治疗干预的分子靶点。
